probability_palette.method: Exact RGB values and percentage boundaries read from the published HRRR ANN-CSGD PNG colorbar. The displayed scale starts at 0.1% with gray; probabilities below 0.1% are unfilled.

probability_map_layout.left_panel: MRMS accumulated precipitation at common 0.25-degree verification points with display-interpolated threshold contour
probability_map_layout.right_panel: ANN/GNN exceedance probability with exact MRMS-exceeding scoring-cell outline

point_hover_inspector.verification_support: Nearest original common 0.25-degree point within 0.20 degree
values: local Brier error or rainfall error
